Its site criteria are exemption criteria, including historic resources designated by January 1, 2025 (Sec. 2.H, which a recital reads as including HCMs and HPOZs). candidate_components.label: Historic resource designated on a local register as of January 1, 2025 (HCM or HPOZ)
candidate_components.pinpoint: Ordinance 188968, Sec. 2.H, page 5, with the recital on page 3

excerpts.text: H. A site with a historic resource designated as of January 1,2025, on a local register (Gov. Code Sec. 65912.161(b)(1)(F)).

WHEREAS, for the purpose of phasing the implementation, sites with a historic resource designated as of January 1,2025 on a local register shall include Historic Cultural Monuments (HCM) and Historic Preservation Overlay Zones (HPOZ), consistent with Government Code Section 65912.161(b)(1)(F);

new_facts_needed: hpoz-or-hcm-designated-by-2025-01-01: yes/no with the designation date, from the City's HCM and HPOZ records.
candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: A dated designation fact; hpoz alone has no date.
candidate_components.proposed_rule_if_reviewer_agrees: HCM or HPOZ designated on or before January 1, 2025 -> temporarily exempt (Sec. 2.H) -> disqualifying_per_source during the exemption period. Otherwise no result from this component (Sec. 4 may exempt the parcel anyway).
judgment_or_ambiguity: The HCM and HPOZ reading comes from a recital, not an operative section.
This is a temporary-exemption criterion, so it belongs in la_sb79.temporary-exemption.
'Historic resource designated on a local register' may cover more than HCMs and HPOZs.

candidate_components.label: Zoning: only a capacity comparison with SB 79's standards

excerpts.text: A. A site that has been identified by the City which permits density and a residential floor area ratio at no less than 50 percent of the standards specified in subdivision (a) of Government Code Section 65912.157 (Gov. Code Sec. 65912.161(b)(1)(A)).

candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: A zone class cannot express it; it needs the City's capacity identification.
judgment_or_ambiguity: The ordinance sets no zoning-designation standard. Its only zoning-related test compares permitted capacity with SB 79's standards, which are in state law (not captured).

candidate_components.label: Specific Plans: not addressed; a TOD alternative plan is a different instrument

excerpts.text: E. A site that is covered by a local transit-oriented development alternative plan adopted by the City (Gov. Code Sec. 65912.161(b)(1)(C)).

judgment_or_ambiguity: The ordinance does not mention Specific Plans. Sec. 4 also says a later TOD alternative plan will not affect the ordinance.

candidate_components.label: Existing housing: no criterion in the ordinance
